existing_features.title: Update the report submission UI to capture the user’s current geolocation using the browser geolocation API and include it in the report payload when submitting.
Display captured geolocation on report viewing surfaces and include it in CSV exports.

new_feature_requests.summary: Add geolocation capture to report submission
Extend the backend DailyServiceReport data model to store optional geolocation captured at report submission time, and persist it with each report.
Add a conditional state migration for existing deployments so previously stored reports remain readable after adding the new geolocation fields.

projectName: Add geolocation capture to service report submission
